name: Santa Stack
author: Ritchie-JBH
description: After one too many post-delivery sherrys, Santa has found himself in a pickle! His sleigh is good for firewood, his reindeers have scarpered and his magic sack is spilling out gifts... With all these deliveries left to do, who's he gonna call? JBH! Our van-packing skills are legendary throughout the land (well, Northumberland), and it's up to us to SAVE CHRISTMAS!
